## The opcode

For example `op_4ba`.

## The meaning

What the opcode does in the game.

## The evidence

Give the scripts and the offsets where you see the opcode, from
`dlplayer disasm`. Tell what the game shows or plays at that point.
Write a short line of the listing, not a dump of the text of the game.

## How sure you are

- [ ] Verified in the game
- [ ] Inferred from the listings
